method: Date-by-date news searches, followed by source checks for candidate fatalities and new dated commitments. This is a researched update, not an exhaustive census of all deaths or announcements. September 21 is an incomplete UTC day. Source names identify publishers or wire services; syndicated URLs are retained.

record.title: Drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk
record.description: Three people were killed in separate drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk, according to local authorities. The city council reported three incidents within about 90 minutes.

events.note: Use the Kramatorsk-specific toll, not the articles' larger daily Ukraine totals. Daytime September 12 local time is also September 12 UTC.

record.title: N1 minibus collision in Western Cape
record.location: Between Leeu Gamka and Prince Albert, Western Cape, South Africa
record.description: A collision involving two minibuses and an SUV killed at least 21 people, according to Western Cape officials. Three of the reported victims died after being taken to hospital.

events.note: Reported shortly after midnight September 14 SAST, corresponding to September 13 UTC. Reports differ on the exact hour but agree on the UTC day.

record.title: Drone strike on passenger bus in Nikopol district
record.description: A drone strike on a passenger bus killed five people, according to regional authorities, who attributed the attack to Russian forces.

events.note: Morning September 16 local time is the same UTC date; perpetrator attribution is explicitly sourced to officials.

record.title: SUV and Metro bus collision in Chatsworth
record.location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
record.description: Two people died and six others were injured when an SUV collided with a Metro bus, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

events.note: September 15 at 17:03 PDT converts to September 16 at 00:03 UTC. Separate from the later helicopter crash.

record.title: News helicopter crash in Chatsworth
record.location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
record.description: A television news helicopter crashed while covering a nearby traffic collision. Two people aboard the aircraft and one person on the ground were killed.

events.note: Shortly before 19:00 PDT September 15 is September 16 UTC. Do not include the two deaths in the separate bus collision.

record.title: Fatal flooding near Newcomb on the Navajo Nation
record.location: Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area, New Mexico, United States
record.description: Two adults and a child died in flooding on the Navajo Nation. Police said their bodies were found near the Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area following overnight flooding.

events.note: Reported around 00:30 MDT September 16. Both the preceding late evening and this report time fall on September 16 UTC; exact time of death is not asserted.

record.title: Fatal debris from drone interception near Taif
record.description: Saudi civil defence said debris from an intercepted drone killed a Yemeni resident and injured two other people. Saudi authorities attributed the drone launch to Yemen's Houthis.

events.note: Death and attribution are reported by Saudi authorities; no independent attribution is claimed.

record.title: Bombing and gun attack on police headquarters in Kohat
record.description: A bombing and gun attack on a police compound killed at least 31 people, according to the victim toll reported by authorities on September 19. The attack began the previous afternoon.

events.note: Use the September 18 attack date and updated September 19 victim toll. Reports differ on police and injury subtotals; omit those. Attackers killed are reported separately and are not added to 31.

record.title: Fatal strike in Jabalia
record.description: A strike in Jabalia killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry records only the Jabalia death, not the larger daily Gaza toll.

events.note: Reuters was published September 20 but describes Saturday September 19. Both reports identify the Jabalia death; their other daily deaths are different and must not be summed.

record.title: Fatal strike in Shuja'iyya
record.description: A strike in Shuja'iyya killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry excludes other deaths reported elsewhere in Gaza that day.

events.note: Same reporting-date distinction as Jabalia. Record separate locations to avoid conflating the sources' different three-death aggregates.

record.title: Fatal shooting near Neve Tzuf
record.location: Near Neve Tzuf, occupied West Bank
record.description: A Palestinian gunman shot dead an Israeli man near Neve Tzuf, according to Israeli authorities. The suspect was subsequently detained.

events.note: Late-morning local reporting corresponds to September 20 UTC. Avoid claims about the victim's civilian or military status not established by both sources.

record.title: Palestinian motorist killed near Ganim
record.location: Near Ganim, Jenin area, occupied West Bank
record.description: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian motorist. The Israeli military alleged an attempted vehicle attack; Reuters said it could not independently verify the circumstances.

events.note: Separate from the Neve Tzuf shooting. The death is reported by both sources; the military's account of motive and circumstances remains an attributed allegation.

record.title: Reported airstrike on displacement camp in Kunar
record.description: Afghan provincial officials said an airstrike killed three people at a camp for families displaced by an earthquake. They attributed the strike to Pakistan; Pakistan's military had not commented in the cited initial report.

events.note: Ariana quotes the police spokesman placing the strike around 03:00 Afghanistan time September 21, corresponding to 22:30 UTC September 20. Do not combine unrelated Paktika strikes with this toll.

promises.promise: End the double-track system in senior high schools by the end of 2027.
promises.description: Mahama set a year-end 2027 target for ending the system that alternates student attendance to accommodate limited school capacity.
promises.evidence: The presidency documented the commitment on September 11; Ghana News Agency reported a subsequent reiteration. These sources establish the target, not its fulfillment.

promises.promise: Target commissioning the SDD-UBIDS library complex in 2027.
promises.description: During a university visit, Mahama said he looked forward to commissioning the library complex in 2027. The due date represents the end of that stated target year, not an announced ceremony date.
promises.evidence: The university's account of the September 12 visit records the 2027 target. Completion has not been established.
sources: SDD University of Business and Integrated Development Studies

promises.role: Federal government led by Prime Minister Mark Carney
promises.promise: Double Canada's preferential trade-market access over the next six months.
promises.description: The Prime Minister's Office stated a six-month market-access target alongside the Canada Investment Summit. The due date is six calendar months after the announcement.
promises.evidence: The official release states the target while describing existing trade agreements and prospective access from ASEAN to India; it does not demonstrate that the expansion has already happened.

promises.promise: Provide C$150 billion in financing over five years to support Canadian economic growth.
promises.description: TD announced a five-year financing commitment covering lending, underwriting and advisory activity. This is not a pledge to invest the full amount as the bank's own cash. The due date is the five-year anniversary of the announcement.
promises.evidence: TD's September 14 announcement establishes the commitment; the Prime Minister's Office included it in the September 15 summit summary. Fulfillment remains pending.

promises.promise: Aim to invest an additional C$10 billion in Canada by the end of 2027, subject to investment-return objectives.
promises.description: The pension fund set a conditional investment objective, not an unconditional spending guarantee. Investments remain subject to its return requirements.
promises.evidence: The fund's September 11 announcement states the amount, end-2027 horizon and return condition; Canada's summit release subsequently reported the commitment.

withheld.candidate: Banga National High School shooting, September 18
withheld.reason: Conflicting contemporaneous official-source tolls: provincial government and PNA report three including the shooter; DSWD-based reporting gives six. Resolve the discrepancy before adding a definitive total.
Three deaths corroborated, but the incident occurred before a 03:01 local report and the UTC date may be September 14. No event time established.

withheld.reason: Syndicated page date conflicts with a September 7 dateline and photograph; do not add a potentially duplicated or misdated event.

withheld.candidate: Indonesia Virgo ferry recovery reported September 20
withheld.reason: New body-recovery coverage is not evidence of a new incident on that day; original date and existing-record overlap not resolved.
Several commitments did not have a sufficiently explicit implementation deadline for the current promise schema.

withheld.candidate: New England flooding September 13 and Java earthquake September 12
withheld.reason: No established fatalities in the examined reporting; not eligible for this fatal-events dataset.

focus: track-a: leaders/governments (Ghana education targets and Canadian trade target); supplemental Canadian finance commitments
